imre: Imre: Rung seven. Second best on the ladder for nine years. I've made peace with it. Mostly with drink.
imre_intro: Imre: Beat me and you meet Dario. Lose and you meet the floor. I recommend the floor.
imre_defeat: Imre: Third best, then. A new low. Refreshing.
dario: Dario: Champion. Mother's idea. I wanted to be a baker. Bread doesn't throw sand in your eyes.
dario_intro: Dario: Rung eight. Nobody's ever beaten me. Mother made sure of that. I'd like to know how it feels.
dario_defeat: Dario: So that's losing. Lighter than I thought. Go get your purse. Read the back first.
